headline: Main Event
caption:
UPDATE: Yair Rodriguez vs. Steve Garcia just got bumped up to a main event.
Pantera or Garcia? 👇

The featherweight fight is off UFC 335 in December and now headlines UFC Dallas on Jan. 16 at American Airlines Center. Daniel Rodriguez vs. Roberto Soldic is the co-main.

🔥 Hot take: This is a must-win for Yair to stay a featherweight contender.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Pantera or Garcia?
